{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out invalid ages: assume age must be between 0 and 120
valid_age_mask = (sales['customer_age'] >= 0) & (sales['customer_age'] <= 120)

# Filter for converted customers AND valid age
converted_and_valid = sales.loc[(sales['converted'] == 1) & valid_age_mask]

# Compute mean age of converted customers with valid age
mean_age_converted = converted_and_valid['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(converted_and_valid)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (valid age only): {mean_age_converted}")

# Output the result
mean_age_converted"}
